protocol.scope: PROVISIONAL available-family diagnostic; not the requested full audit
protocol.purge: 10 km groups touching held-out region plus 1.5 km collar are excluded from training
protocol.effect_rule: Holm p<=.05 AND AUC>=.55 AND margin over grouped-null p95>=.02
protocol.shift_rule: diagnostic only, not an exact p-value on a nonstationary irregular region

road_m.limitations: Census roads/vehicular and available pedestrian trails; not a complete hiking-trail inventory. 100 m rasterization.

claim_m.quality_policy: leading numeric QLTY code <=10; unknown/degraded/25 county-only excluded; broad geometries rejected
claim_m.limitation: PLSS legal-land approximations, often quarter-section precision; not exact historic claim stakes or workings

area1.source: USGS official Area1/Area2 outline shapefiles (Area1 priority)

missing_required: buffered nearest-road coverage (legacy mirror was clipped tightly)
verified geographic boundaries of the four acquisition blocks

supersession_reason: The v2 nuisance feature set substituted Area1 membership for true four-block membership; the 10 km whole-group flip null assumed unverified exchangeability; and its spatial shifts used toroidal np.roll across an irregular footprint. Archived AUCs remain for provenance only.
